message: My two preliminary research projects, "Design of Progress-Aware Hint Systems for CTF-Based Cybersecurity Education" and "Supporting Instructor Diagnosis and Response to Infrastructure Failures in Networked Educational Robotics Activities", will be presented in the SIGCSE TS 2027 Poster Session in Sacramento, CA, February 17-20, 2027. If you have a chance, drop by and say hi!
